# Accela Citizen Access (ACA) Production

> Multi-jurisdiction government services platform enabling citizens to apply for permits, track inspections, search properties, and manage licenses online across multiple municipalities.

Accela Citizen Access is a cloud-based portal serving multiple cities and counties including Mesa, Polk County, Palo Alto, Sacramento, and others. It streamlines permit applications, inspections, and property management for construction, planning, and business licensing across jurisdictions.

## Key Topics

- Accela Citizen Access
- Permit Applications
- Construction Permits
- Planning Applications
- Building Inspections
- Property Search
- Permit Tracking
- Online Applications
- Fee Payment
- Account Registration
- Business Licenses
- Code Compliance
- Land Development
- Inspection Tracker
- Government Services

## City & County Portals

- [Mesa E-Permit Online Portal](https://aca-prod.accela.com/mesa/Default.aspx?culture=en-US): Mesa e-permit portal for construction permits, planning, and licenses
- [Polk County Citizen Access](https://aca-prod.accela.com/POLKCO/Default.aspx?culture=en-US): Polk County portal for permits, property search, and inspections
- [Palo Alto Citizen Access](https://aca-prod.accela.com/PALOALTO/Dashboard.aspx?TabName=Home): Palo Alto citizen portal for permit management and tracking
- [Sacramento Citizen Access](https://aca-prod.accela.com/sacramento/Default.aspx): Sacramento city portal for building and planning permits
- [County of Fresno Citizen Access](https://aca-prod.accela.com/COF/Dashboard.aspx?TabName=Home): Citizen portal dashboard for application management and permits
